Container.Name: plex-language-sync
Container.Overview:
Set preferred audio and subtitle languages per show; every new episode follows automatically.
Watches Plex playback in real time. When you pick an audio or subtitle track on one episode, the same choice is applied to the rest of the show, for that Plex user. It also learns your audio-to-subtitle habits and applies them to brand new shows before you press play. Multi-user aware, no web UI, no open port: a single small container that talks to your Plex server.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: plex audio subtitle language track auto-languages
Container.Requires: Plex URL: the full URL of your Plex server including scheme and port, for example http://192.0.2.100:32400 (use the server's LAN IP, not a container name). Plex Token: the server administrator's token, from Plex Web: Settings, then the XML view of any item, then myPlexAccessToken. Multi-user support fetches shared user tokens from plex.tv, so the container needs internet access. Raise the Docker stop time-out to 20 seconds or more (Settings, Docker, advanced view) so the final cache save completes on stop.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Full URL of your Plex Media Server including scheme and port, e.g. http://192.0.2.100:32400

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Plex authentication token of the server administrator (Plex Web: Settings, XML view, myPlexAccessToken)

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent cache: learned language profiles, shared-user tokens and sync state

Config.Name: Update level
Config.Description: Scope of language propagation: show applies to all episodes of the show, season only to the current season

Config.Name: Update strategy
Config.Description: Which episodes to update: all updates every episode in scope, next only the episodes after the one being played

Config.Name: Trigger on play
Config.Description: React to playback events: playing an episode propagates its language settings

Config.Name: Trigger on scan
Config.Description: React to library scans: newly added or updated episodes get each user's recorded selection for the show

Config.Name: Learn language profiles
Config.Description: Learn audio-to-subtitle language pairs from playback and apply them to brand new shows with no watch history

Config.Name: Subtitle match tier
Config.Description: How far a subtitle substitution may reach when no exact language match exists: identical, same-language, other-script, intelligible or shared-literacy

Config.Name: Deep scan interval
Config.Description: Cadence of the deep-scan safety net as a Go duration (24h, 12h); off disables it

Config.Name: Ignore labels
Config.Description: Comma-separated Plex labels that exclude a show from language sync (exact, case-sensitive; setting this replaces the defaults)

Config.Name: Ignore libraries
Config.Description: Comma-separated Plex library names to exclude entirely (exact, case-sensitive)

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Minimum log level: debug, info, warn or error; debug shows per-event skip reasons and stream-matching detail

Config.Name: Plex CA certificate path
Config.Description: Only for an https Plex URL with a self-signed or private-CA certificate: in-container path of the CA PEM file (add a matching path mapping)
